allow: Bash(powershell -Command "Write-Host ''Waiting for Docker daemon...''; for \($i=0; $i -lt 60; $i++\) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; try { docker info 2>$null | Out-Null; if \($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0\) { Write-Host ''Docker is ready''; exit 0 } } catch {} }; Write-Host ''Docker not ready after 2 minutes''")
